names.note: Name page 9760 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Петр (Голубев), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Петра пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and no folder in this corpus carries «Голубев» in any form — the eleven bare «Петр» folders are a fold this form stays clear of.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 21 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Петра пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's sixth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 9760 «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/peter-golubev*` was empty and a Cyrillic grep for «Голубев» over every `saint.json` returned nothing. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
